"""Record an actual intro-only edit and unchanged, previously executed notebooks."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/workspace/tiny-perceptron-vlm')
lesson = sys.argv[1]
groups = json.loads(Path('/tmp/final-audit-groups.json').read_bytes())
item = next(item for group in groups.values() for item in group if item['id'] == lesson)
source = item['source']
sha = lambda raw: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
old_raw = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + source], cwd=root)
new_raw = (root / source).read_bytes()

def split(raw):
    hs = list(re.finditer(rb'(?m)^## ([A-Z\d]+\.\d+) [^\r\n]+', raw))
    return raw[:hs[0].start()], {h[1].decode():raw[h.start():hs[i+1].start() if i+1 < len(hs) else len(raw)] for i,h in enumerate(hs)}

old_intro, old_parts = split(old_raw)
new_intro, new_parts = split(new_raw)
assert next(iter(new_parts)) == lesson
assert old_intro != new_intro and old_parts == new_parts
command = ['.venv/bin/python', 'scripts/build_course.py', '--check']
checked = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, env=os.environ | {'OMP_NUM_THREADS':'1','MKL_NUM_THREADS':'1'}, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)
baseline_path = root / 'docs/validation-artifacts/reader-round-notebook-kernels.json'
baseline_raw = baseline_path.read_bytes()
baseline = json.loads(baseline_raw)
assert baseline['status'] == 'passed' and baseline['result']['total'] == baseline['result']['passed'] == 222 and baseline['result']['failed'] == 0
record_by_path = {r['notebook']:r for r in baseline['records']}
records = []
for path in sorted((root / 'notebooks' / Path(source).stem).glob('*.ipynb')):
    relative = str(path.relative_to(root))
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    assert raw == subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + relative], cwd=root)
    prior = record_by_path[relative]
    executed_path = root / 'outputs/notebooks-reader-round' / path.relative_to(root / 'notebooks')
    executed_raw = executed_path.read_bytes()
    assert sha(raw) == prior['input_sha256'] and sha(executed_raw) == prior['executed_sha256']
    a,b = json.loads(raw),json.loads(executed_raw)
    assert len(a['cells']) == len(b['cells'])
    for ca,cb in zip(a['cells'],b['cells'],strict=True):
        assert ca['cell_type'] == cb['cell_type'] and ca['source'] == cb['source']
        if ca['cell_type'] == 'code':
            assert isinstance(cb['execution_count'],int) and cb['execution_count'] > 0
            assert all(o['output_type'] != 'error' for o in cb.get('outputs',[]))
    records.append({'notebook':relative,'input_sha256':sha(raw),'executed_sha256':sha(executed_raw),'unchanged_from_head':True,'actual_prior_kernel_receipt':'docs/validation-artifacts/reader-round-notebook-kernels.json','cell_sources_match':True,'no_error_outputs':True})
assert records and any(Path(r['notebook']).stem == lesson for r in records)
assert (root / source).read_bytes() == new_raw
report = {
    'schema_version':1,'checked_at':datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),'status':'passed','lesson_id':lesson,'source':source+'#'+lesson,
    'source_sha256':sha(new_parts[lesson]),'intro_sha256':sha(new_intro),'previous_intro_sha256':sha(old_intro),
    'verification_checkout':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip(),
    'scope':'Actual read-only verification of an intro-only author edit. Every section body and every chapter notebook is unchanged. Current notebook inputs and executed outputs match the actual earlier whole CPU kernel run, with matching cell sources and no error outputs. This command does not execute kernels or review understanding/factual correctness, and does not claim remote Colab execution.',
    'previous_intro':old_intro.decode(),'current_intro':new_intro.decode(),'all_section_bodies_unchanged':True,
    'notebook_count':len(records),'kernel_reruns':0,'baseline_receipt_sha256':sha(baseline_raw),'records':records,
    'build_check':{'command':command,'exit_code':checked.returncode,'stdout':checked.stdout,'stderr':checked.stderr},
    'verification_program':Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
path=root / f'docs/validation-artifacts/technical-revision-{lesson}-intro-scope.json'
path.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'receipt':str(path.relative_to(root)),'status':'passed','intro_changed':True,'section_bodies_changed':0,'notebooks_unchanged':len(records),'kernel_reruns':0}))
